description: Reads a WhatsApp chat, oldest first, ending with the latest message (or the last before the time given in before). chat is an id from whatsapp_find, or a person's or group's name.

before.description: Only messages before this time (ISO 8601), to read further back

chat.description: The chat's id from whatsapp_find, or its name

limit.description: At most this many messages (default 50, up to 200)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

name: whatsapp_read
title: Read a WhatsApp Chat
